## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, affected models and resulting behavior.

## References

For model or mathematical changes, link the manual section, independent expected result and justified tolerance.

## Validation

- [ ] Existing tests retained; relevant regression added
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:ui` on Windows
- [ ] `npm run release:win` and packaged application checks
- [ ] Both interface languages and affected model workflows checked
- [ ] Compatibility documentation, README translations and changelog updated as needed
- [ ] Dependency licenses, audit and notices reviewed if dependencies changed

List actual pass/fail/not-run counts, environment, evidence and reasons for skipped checks. An unchecked box is not a passed check.

## Remaining limitations

State unverified hardware behavior, numerical edge cases or migration risks.
